title: Our partner stamp
slide_intent: Introduce a compact identifier for affiliation so audiences can recognize a partner’s relationship to Frontline AIDS on the partner’s own material.
strategic_value: A consistent stamp can communicate that relationship while leaving the partner’s identity in the lead.
demonstration: The black stamp appears large on gray, then appears again in a clear-space diagram surrounded by alignment guides and faint symbol references.
practical_value: Use the supplied stamp artwork for affiliation and apply the clearance shown in the diagram before placing adjacent copy or imagery.

content_islands.name: Partnership guidance
content_islands.spec: Set the heading, role explanation and asset reference in the white text column.

content_islands.name: Stamp specimen
content_islands.spec: Center the large stamp on the gray field and keep its enclosing line, symbol and Partner text intact.

content_islands.name: Clear-space construction
content_islands.spec: Align the smaller diagram beneath the specimen. Show the required breathing room around the outer boundary with guides.
